topic: Myth: You Need Years of Trading History to Qualify
objective: Correct a common misconception: 'You Need Years of Trading History to Qualify'.

slides.subheadline: Some lenders specialise in newer businesses.

slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: While some lenders do require long trading history, others assess newer businesses using different criteria — director experience, security or industry-specific factors. Trading history requirements vary far more than most people expect.

caption:
This assumption stops a lot of newer businesses from even asking — but trading history requirements vary enormously across the lending market, and several lenders specialise specifically in newer businesses.
